svg.title: Experimental driver warning / 实验驱动警告
svg.desc: You MUST carefully read the entire README.md before installation. 安装前必须认真阅读完整 README.md。 Black screen or boot failure possible. Working reports only for 1.15.0, 2.0.1 and 2.0.2. Installer selects a matching 1.15.0, 2.0.1 or 2.0.2 build. 可能黑屏或无法启动；仅反馈 1.15.0、2.0.1 和 2.0.2 可用，安装器按版本匹配 1.15.0、2.0.1 或 2.0.2。

g.text: WARNING — EXPERIMENTAL DRIVER / 警告：实验驱动
Reported working: 1.15.0 / 2.0.1 / 2.0.2 only. Other versions are UNVERIFIED.
仅反馈 1.15.0 / 2.0.1 / 2.0.2 可用，其他版本未验证，可能黑屏或无法启动。
Back up first. Verify Recovery. Installer accepts 1.15.0 / 2.0.1 / 2.0.2 ONLY.
先备份并确认 Recovery 可用；安装器仅接受 1.15.0 / 2.0.1 / 2.0.2，按版本匹配驱动。
You MUST carefully read the entire README.md before installation.
安装前必须认真阅读完整 README.md，特别是安装、回退及注意事项。
